name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: You want someone who sets the standard and then builds it, and that's how I work. I architect CRMs in HubSpot and GoHighLevel from the properties up: lifecycle stages, lead scoring, routing, and data-hygiene rules. I build the integrations that connect them to everything else through webhooks, REST APIs, Zapier, Make, and n8n, and I install conversion tracking myself through GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads tags.

On the measurement side, I build dashboards in Power BI and SQL, including BigQuery pulls of GA4 data, and turn them into recommendations for leadership. Before marketing operations I spent a decade in B2B sales, including ranking top three at Accelo selling complex software through long, multi-stakeholder cycles, so I build routing and handoffs with the sales side in mind.
HubSpot Marketing Hub Enterprise at BAMKO's scale and a formal multi-touch attribution model would be where I'd grow fastest. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
